name: Densest packings of two translates of a lattice in R^4 (theorem; the 24-cell conjecture stays open)
target: Lambda u (Lambda + b) in R^4 with minimal distance 2 has covolume >= 16, with equality only for sqrt2 D4
result: Proved; the general D4 / 24-cell conjecture is not.

notes.formal: Lean proves the sign lemma and evaluates every certificate; the analytic part is not formalized
